Oh, my guest! Welcome.\nYou must be tired for taking care of Jeila and\nPumpking. Make yourself comfortable.
It's good to think about attractions to amuse guests\nbut now it turned into a way to have everything on\ntheir own way... That gives me a headache...
But they're cute actually.\nAfter they noticed that I was lonely, they all\nvisit my house recently.
I was making sweets for them not knowing when\nthey come, but now I'm excited to make a lot.\nI might be spoiling them though...
HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Zoe!!

Kyaaaaa!!
Ouch... This is too much...\nWho can do such a...
It's me!
I knew it... What are you doing, Mother!
Whaaaaaat?!
Mother, what are you doing?!\nWhat is it for?!
How did you like Zoe's house? Do you like it?\n...How about us, you ask? Of course we like it!!\nHer sweets as well!! But kinda bored now...
Zoe's sweets are so good but now I wanna have\nthe cheap sweets I was eating in this season...
I'll collect them
Maybe next time
You can collect sweets for me? Yay!\nOkay, now I'll tell you the ones I need.\nBe sure to remember all correctly, won't you?
Well, I like well-baked sweets.\nSo, firstly, get 10 [ffff64]Pumpkin Cookies[ffffff] for me, please.
So, the second one is 10 [ffff64]Jack Puddings[ffffff].\nAnd the third is... What? Too many?\nYou want me to curse again, huh?
Just stop whining and let's get to the third one.\nThey're all sweet, so I need something salty.\n10 [ffff64]Pumpkin Soup[ffffff]. That's it! Thanks in advance.
Oh, hey! How did it go?\n...Aww, not yet? It's not hard for you, is it?\nMeh, hurry.
Thank yooou!! You've got all of them!\nI like Zoe's sweets but sometimes I want them.\nWell, enjoy her house!

Oh, I was just wondering where you are.\nDid you walk around the house? ...No?\nThere are many interesting stuffs in here.
Zoe? She's so kind. She listens to me with smile.\nWhen I told her about the sweets that I like,\nshe said she would make the ones.
But she has never had those sweets so she said\nshe wanted to taste it.\nBut I don't have them...
So, I want someone to collect the ingredients\nso she can try to make the sweets...
I'll collect them
Maybe next time
I'm counting on ya. I like kinda spicy sweets.\nSo, my first choice is 10 [ffff64]Ginger Cakes[ffffff].
The second one is candy.\n10 [ffff64]Pumpkin Candies[ffffff], please.
Oh, have you got them? ...Aw, not yet?\nShe needs them to make the sweets.\nPlease hurry.
Oh, there they are!!\nNow Zoe can taste the sweets.\nThanks. Enjoy looking around the house.

Oh, nice timing, pom.\nCan you collect sweets for me, pom?\nI'm begging you, pom!
Why, you ask, pom? I wanna give them to Zoe, pom.\nShe's so kind, pom. She treats me very kindly, pom.
So, I wanna give the best sweets ever I had other\nthan Zoe's in return, pom.
But it would take forever if I tried to collect\nthem, pom... So, I want you to collect them, pom!\nPlease help me out, pom!
I'll collect them
Maybe next time
You can go collect the sweets I want?\nI'm so happy, pom! Thanks, pom!
So, I'll tell you the ones I want.\nI like the sweets full of dried fruits!
So, I want you to get 10 [ffff64]Barmbrack[ffffff] at first.\nIt's a bit difficult to collect but I wish you\ngood luck, pom.
The second one tastes super hot at first but\nsoon it tastes slightly sweet and I really like\nit! 10 [ffff64]Zombie Cake[ffffff], please!
Got the sweets, pom? Not yet, pom...\nI wanna give her my gifts now, pom...\nCollect asap, pom...
Welcome back, pom! Now I can give them to her, pom!\nHave you went around the house, pom?\n...Okay, I hope you enjoy, pom!

Mother! Why did you do this?!\nAnswer me!!
What? What did she say?
I can't hear her, pom.
I was so lonely! You guys never came back after\nyou left this house... You never know how lonely\nI was to be here alone!!
She said [You guys] but we have nothing to do with\nher...
We do have something to do with her...
Are you alright, pom?!
Huh?
I mean, you were kidnapped by her, right...?
What are you talking about?\nZoe invited me to the house.
I was just sleeping in this quiet room while\nshe was making sweets!
You said we had something to do with her.\nWhat do you mean?
Zoe created us as the Pumpking!
Whaaaaaat?!
I didn't know it, pom!!
No wonder you didn't.\nOnly I have the memory when she created us.
Huh? Only you...?
Of course. The Pumpking's head is me.\nYou are body, hands and legs.\nHow can you have memories?
Is... Is that so, pom?
I'm... I'm still don't get it...
She made these sweets for the time when we come\nback, you know?
So, we can come back any time after we left...
Mother, I'm sorry...\nPlease forgive me...
I'm sorry for getting you involved in our problem.\nYou didn't have time to play, right?
...You had fun enough? Then, that's good.\nCome play with us again when you have time.\nYou're always welcome.
You're leaving already?\nI'll make more interesting games by the time\nyou come again. So, come again for sure♪
Thanks for helping us out.\nJacky was safe and now we know who our mom is.\nI'm so happy right now.
Many things happened. Are you still confused, pom?\n...I like you because you even enjoy troubles, pom!\nCome again, pom!
I'm sorry for all the troubles that my kids\ncaused. We made up thanks to your help.
Right now I don't have anything to give you, so\nplease come again when you have time.\nWe'll be waiting for your visit.

Welcome back all!\nI was looking forward to seeing you!!
Mother, I'm back!
I'm back, Zoe!
Um, uh... I'm back... I guess?
I... I'm back, pom...
Oh, my sweet Pumpking, welcome back!\nI made a lot of sweets for you guys, too!!
Really, pom?!
Mine, too?! Great!
That's our creator!\nI love you Zoe!!
Oh, here's another guest? Oh, you are!\nYou brought me and kids together!!
We met here before we come here.\nSo, we came together.
Welcome to my house.\nI can't offer any great hospitality but I hope\nyou enjoy this unusual house.
I've made sweets for you guys.\nMake yourself at home.
Yaaaaay!!
Feel free to walk around the house.\nIf you want something from me, visit the basement.\nYou can come if you wanna kill time.
Thanks for playing with us.
Few people can face the kids' tall orders and my\nserious games.
I look forward to seeing you again.
It's only you who overwhelmed mom\nas long as I can remember. You're awesome.\nAs she said, I want to see you again.
We'll have Mother's sweets a lot and get stronger!
Hope to see you in the next year too.\nLet's play with us then. I can't wait♪
I miss you...
Take care of youself in your world, pom!

You don't have to call! You don't have to beg!\nCuz I'll still come!
Stop! I've heard enough of it!
How could you put those kids in danger!!
What?!\nThey went to father's mansion without permission?
I don't wanna hear any excuses!\nFor the time being, you're not allowed to leave\nthis house!!
W-what the, this is so sudden...
Oh no?! Father, does that mean...\nwe're grounded?!
Yeah, it seems like it...\nIt's gonna take a while whenever Zoe loses her\ntemper like that...
Oh no wayyy!\nWe have a guest now, what should we do with the\nHalloween preparation?!
Relax, my dear daughter! I knew this kind of thing\nwould happen, so I brought a new sweets recipe\nthat could make Zoe happy.
We could fix Zoe's mood if we make them!
So, how could we collect the ingredients?\nWe can't go out.
Hm!
Hm!\nIt can't be helped!
Hm!\nIt can't be helped!\nLet's forget it!!
Father, you gave up too soon!
Oh, come to think of it, the guest...\nwas fine right?
Yeah. I believe Zoe wouldn't go that far...\nOh, nice!
We're no longer allowed to go out no matter what.
So, I need your help.\nCould you go out to collect these ingredients?\nSay yes or okay.
Father, what kind of way to ask for help was\nthat...
Yes!!
Okay? Maybe no...
Sorry for troubling you again...
Don't feel bad about it!\nIt's normal for kids to trouble adults after all!
But now it's father and mother that are giving the\nguest trouble, not me! Please think about what\nyou've done!!
Hey, we'll try to persuade Zoe too, but in the\nmeantime, please collect the ingredients...
Wait a sec! Why are you still considering it?!
Please! We can only count on you!\nI'll stop being picky and eat meat from now on!
Father, you do love meat okay...
Oops! Busted! I don't wanna get scolded!
Were you being honest when you said you didn't\nwanna get scolded?! Seriously!! If you really mean\nit, then it can't be helped!
What?!\n...Y-you'll go? Thanks!
We're counting on you!\nWe'll try to persuade Zoe too...\nAlthough I think it's impossible!
There's nothing to be proud of, you know!!
Hihihi...nice. I shoulda done this from the start.\nIt'll be fine if I keep everyone at my\nfingertips...No one's going anywhere...
Zoe seems to be lost in a world of her own...
Ummm...\nMother seems very persistent this time.
Hahaha, that's because Zoe is lonely!
I think mother is really serious this time.\nSorry again, but...please collect the ingredients.
Ahh~...Zoe.\nWe wanna get ready quickly for Halloween too...
Actually, we couldn't go out cuz Zoe cast the\nspell on us too...
Angry Zoe is scary pom.\nIt was our fault for making her angry tho pom...
Oh, the ingredients are complete? Hurry up then!
With those, Zoe will be happy!
Let's hurry and bring them to Zarth, pom!
It's amazing that you collected all of this!\nWell, Father, hurry up and make them!
Yeah! I could just make them according to the\nrecipe!
So, just quickly make them!
Yeah! Just make them according to the recipe!
Father, don't tell me that you don't know how to\nmake them?
I've got the recipe, but I've never said that I\nknow how to make them!
Why are you only telling us about it after we've\ngot the ingredients!! This is stupid! Father,\nyou're stupid!!
What?! I'm not stupid!\nZoe always says that I can do anything if I put my\nmind to it! She always compliments me!
That's not a compliment! Are you a kid?!
Hmm, it's because mother spoils father all the\ntime!! Ooh, what do we do now...
Oh, I know!\nWe can just ask Zoe to make them, right?
Father, do you even know what you're saying!
Give 'em to me...
What?!
I'll make them, so give 'em to me now!
Oh?!\nI-if you're okay with it, fine tho...
We aren't getting anywhere if I don't do so.\nIt can't be helped.
Great! This will put Zoe back in a good mood!
Jeez...the sweets are supposed to be for me to fix\nmy mood, why am I making them by myself...
Mmm! De-lish!
Mother, so tasty.
Zoe's sweets are one-of-a-kind ♪
I can keep eating them!
Everything's good, pom!
What mysterious sweets.\nBut, whatever, as long as the kids love them.
Right, right!
Father, there's no reason for you be puffed up\nwith pride.
Jeez, if I hadn't made them, I wonder what you\nwould have done. You know, you're...
Oh? The sweets are gone already!
I-I'll let it go this time, but it doesn't mean\nI'd always...
What? You're right!
Y-you are too random in the first place.\nYou should at least think...
Oh no, I wanted to eat more, pom.
We still have ingredients left.\nI'll make more, just wait.
For real?! Zoe, I love you so much!
Yaaaas!
I'm so happy pom!
My dear, I'd be happy too if you come home and\nplay with Jeila and the kids more often.
Okay!\nHow could I say no to my beloved wife's request!
You're helping too.\nI want you to carry the sweets that are done.
Hm? You must be wondering how they could stay\nmarried after all this time, right?
Well, it's normal if you think so.\nTo put it simply, mother is physically attracted\nto father.
By the way, it's so muggy, can I put this off now?
No one forces you to put it on, just put it off.
If only he was a little more normal, he would be\na perfect father...
What's wrong, my daughter!\nCome here and help Zoe make sweets!
All right!
Father, Mother! I'm back!\nI brought the guest with me too!
I'm home, pom!
Zarth, Zoe, I'm back!
I'm back home!
Ooh, the guest! Are you enjoying the Halloween?
You know because we were quarreling, the\npreparation to welcome our guest couldn't be done\nproperly!
Oops, that's rude of us! But things like this\nhappen! My mansion, the Zarth's Mansion, is full\nof fantasies and danger. Just go and enjoy it!
You didn't have to say "danger", you know.
Wait a sec! The stuff in your mansion tho, have\nyou checked the safety? No more weird things left?
Yeah! I guess so!
That's not okay...
Mother, I think it's better if we go and check\nFather's mansion once.
That sounds good.\nJust in case, could you come with us too?
Hey, you guys are coming too.
Okay, Zoe!
All right.
I'm coming, pom.
My dear wife! What about me? What should I do?!
You're the most worrying. I need to keep a close\neye on you! You're coming with us!
Father!
Ooh, Jeila!\nYou guys okay?
...Hm?\nI remember our regular visitor, but I've never\nseen her. Who is she?
Oh, we have a new guest this year.\nUhh...
...So, the monsters we've never seen before just\ncame out of nowhere and they've been messing\naround here and there like crazy.
We don't get new guests very often, but the\ncurrent situation doesn't allow us to entertain\nher.
Could you possibly have brought home some weird\nstuff again by accident?
Nope, that shouldn't be the case.\nI've checked everything carefully this time...
Hey, hey, does he really have to strike a pose\nevery time he says something?
What are you talking about?!
Living creatures will die when they stop\nbreathing!!
And that's exactly like what I am doing!!
Ah, I see.\nJust like some fish that die if they stop\nswimming...
Tee-hee-hee...Everyone seems to be gathering here.
Who is it?
Sorry for the late introduction.\nMy name is Wisp...a plain phantom thief. Sorry for\nnot showing myself, just remember my name...
W-where and how did you get in here?!\nAs far as I know, it's not easy to infiltrate\nthis world...!
What? It was easy tho.\nI was hiding among the stuff that husband of yours\nbrought home.
No matter how tight the security is, I'll be safe\nas long as I'm inside...But I was able to move\nfreely since a while ago.
W-what...?!\nSo, was that why the sweets I got from Zoe\nsuddenly disappeared...?
T-that must be her doing!!
T-then...\nThe person who did something to my scale to make\nme weigh 3 kg heavier, was it also...?!
W-was it also her doing?!
And what about the person who suddenly tickled me\nfrom behind causing me to put a hole in the floor\nwhen I was practicing my magic? Was it also...?!
All of those must be her doings!!
Excuse me?! I've no idea what you all are talking\nabout! You're even blaming me for things that\naren't related to stealing!!
But, whatever...Anyway, this place is amazing.\nI asked my minions to search around and this place\nis exactly what people call a treasure mountain!
Really?!\nYaassss! It's worth coming here then!
No matter what, you just can't steal from here!\nMake sure to pay for your purchase!
Yeah!\nAsking for a discount is fine, but you still need\nto pay!
But I'm afraid that what I want can't be bought\nwith money...
Something that money can't buy...\nIs there anything like that here...?
W-whatever it is, the fact that you're not showing\nyourself is not fair! Hurry up and show yourself!!
Hahaha! I can't do that. The thing that contains\nme can store itself in a fold of dimension. It can\nremain in this world without getting noticed.
If that's the case, I'mma just beat it too to\nforce you out of it!
I'm so excited for that...Tee hee hee...
Phantom Wisp...We don't know who she is but if her\nminions are also here that means...
You all said you've seen some weird monsters,\nright? Where did you see them?
I saw them in your mansion!
I saw them in father's mansion!
As for me, I saw them in Jeila's Halloween Castle,\npom!
Umm, I wanna find and get to that Phantom Wisp's\nhideout as soon as possible, but first, we need to\ndeal with those monsters.
This time it feels like that Phantom Wisp is\nthrowing down a challenge to our entire family!
So just this once!
We're gonna solve it!
On our own!\nWithout any outsider involved! I promise!!
So dear adventures, will you do something to deal\nwith the Phantom Wisp?
Father! If you're asking the visitors to help,\nthat means we are not solving the problem on our\nown!
It's okay...Since we've got quite a few people\nhere, it's not a bad idea to split up the work.\nPlus, that creature seems to be moving around...
It's gonna be troublesome if she escapes to\nsomewhere else. Just let us handle that thing!
You're so on fire!
You're not turning it down?
W-w-what's so wrong with me being on fire?\nWe already know there are a lot of treasures and\nwe can expect to get paid handsomely...
Don't worry about the rewards!\nLet me promise to reward you decently with this\ncool pose!
Well, I don't care about your pose, but keep your\nword! Alright, let's go then!
D-don't you think it's okay to\nhelp people in trouble sometimes?!
I know there are many treasures, but I am not\nexpecting any huge reward at all!
Don't worry about the rewards!\nLet me promise to reward you decently with this\ncool pose!
Well, I don't care about your pose,\nwe've already agreed to help!\nAlright, let's go then!
